(() => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-testid="data-testid Panel editor"]'); if(!el) return 'no editor'; const walk=(n,d)=>{let out=[];for(const c of n.children){if(d>6)break;const t=c.getAttribute('data-testid');const txt=(c.childElementCount===0)?(c.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,40):'';out.push('  '.repeat(d)+(c.tagName)+(t?'['+t+']':'')+(txt?' :: '+txt:''));out=out.concat(walk(c,d+1));}return out;}; return JSON.stringify(walk(el,0).slice(0,120),null,0); })()

(() => { const main=document.querySelector('main'); const walk=(n,d)=>{let out=[];for(const c of n.children){if(d>5)continue;const t=c.getAttribute('data-testid')||c.getAttribute('role')||'';const txt=(c.childElementCount===0)?(c.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,30):'';out.push('  '.repeat(d)+c.tagName+(t?'('+t+')':'')+(txt?' :: '+txt:''));out=out.concat(walk(c,d+1));}return out;}; const lines=walk(main,0); return JSON.stringify({n:lines.length, lines: lines.slice(0,150)}); })()

(() => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-testid="data-testid Panel editor content"]'); const walk=(n,d)=>{let out=[];for(const c of n.children){if(d>8)continue;const t=c.getAttribute('data-testid')||'';const txt=(c.childElementCount===0)?(c.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,40):'';out.push('  '.repeat(d)+c.tagName+(t?'('+t+')':'')+(txt?' :: '+txt:''));out=out.concat(walk(c,d+1));}return out;}; const lines=walk(el,0); return JSON.stringify({n:lines.length, lines: lines.slice(0,200)}); })()
